title: One-coordinate dependence of the projection
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, choose a coordinate $i$ of the $(n+1)$-dimensional sign cube, and choose whether to negate its sign. The function on the $n$-dimensional sign cube obtained by evaluating that signed coordinate function on vectors whose first coordinate is $1$ depends on at most one coordinate.
hypotheses_covered: a Boolean choice of whether to negate the signed coordinate
